evals.prompt: I'm starting a new .NET project and want to model an Order aggregate with Eventuous. The order should support placing, confirming, and cancelling. Show me the aggregate, state, and events.
evals.expected_output: Complete Order aggregate with State<OrderState>, domain events (OrderPlaced, OrderConfirmed, OrderCancelled), and Aggregate<OrderState> with Apply methods and business logic guards.

assertions.name: uses-state-record
assertions.check: Code defines OrderState inheriting from State<OrderState>

assertions.name: uses-aggregate-generic
assertions.check: Code defines an aggregate class using Aggregate<OrderState>

assertions.name: defines-three-events
assertions.check: At least 3 domain events defined (place, confirm, cancel)

assertions.name: uses-when-fold
assertions.check: State uses the When() fold pattern to reconstruct from events

assertions.name: has-business-guards
assertions.check: Aggregate methods include state-based guards preventing invalid transitions

evals.prompt: How do I set up a functional command service in Eventuous? I have a Booking state and want to handle BookRoom and CancelBooking commands.
evals.expected_output: Functional CommandService<BookingState> with On<BookRoom>().InState(...).GetStream(...).Act(...) registration, showing pure functions that take state + command and return events.

assertions.name: act-returns-events
assertions.check: The Act handler returns events (IEnumerable or array), not void

assertions.name: handles-both-commands
assertions.check: Both BookRoom and CancelBooking commands are registered

evals.prompt: I'm using Eventuous and need to register my event types and set up DI for an ASP.NET Core app with an event store and subscriptions. What's the minimal setup?
evals.expected_output: TypeMap registration for events, AddEventStore, AddSubscription, and AddCheckpointStore DI calls in Program.cs, with event handler registration.

assertions.name: registers-type-map
assertions.check: Shows TypeMap.RegisterKnownEventTypes() or individual TypeMap.AddType<> calls

assertions.name: registers-event-store
assertions.check: Shows AddEventStore<> or equivalent store registration

assertions.name: registers-subscription
assertions.check: Shows AddSubscription<> for at least one subscription type

assertions.name: registers-event-handler
assertions.check: Shows event handler registration via AddEventHandler or inline

assertions.name: uses-aspnet-builder
assertions.check: Code is in the context of WebApplicationBuilder / Program.cs
